ValidationRule.description: New mandates are raised on UAEDDS only. Structural rather than relying on the Gateway field default, so it survives any insert path that omits the field. Applies on insert only, so existing FAB Legacy records are unaffected.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: New Direct Debit mandates cannot be raised on the FAB gateway. FAB registration is closed and the integration is no longer active. Leave Gateway as UAEDDS.
